entries.notes: Reclassified 2026-05-18 from wrong_verification_command/regressed to high_variance after a fixture-validity audit. The verification-command root cause was already resolved; the fixture itself is valid: the two target test files are absent at benchmark ref commit 180de500, the runner cleanup (reset --hard + clean -fd on every run path) removes untracked leftovers so there is no state leak, and single smoke 260517-222513 produced a clean passing solution. Remaining N=3 instability (260517133604 card_on 0/3 / card_off 0/3) is genuine model output variance on a hard JUnit5+Mockito CREATE task: List<Port> constructor injection defeats @InjectMocks, strict-stub and invented-enum-constant compile errors, and partial 1-of-2 file creation. Fixture-reactive harness patches that lifted run 260517154138 to card_on 2/3 were reverted as patch-style / comparability risk.
